summary: PASS — P15 now delivers the real Windows AppContainer sandbox on a native host: creation-time Job+SECURITY_CAPABILITIES lowbox (dead-stack scope fixed, NULL capabilities for empty arrays, and the 11-key AppContainer base-environment synthesis for the empirically-bisected ERROR_ENVVAR_NOT_FOUND truth), explicit-subtree-only grants with ancestor-traversal grants removed entirely (the second pinned OS truth: SeChangeNotifyPrivilege carries the lowbox through ungranted ancestors, so shared ancestors like C:\Users are never ACL-touched), a three-way network probe against a resolved public endpoint with no listener anywhere (F2 pin restored, r00_a1 green), deny targets outside the grant set, keyring sentinel delete_credential, journal reconcile on every grant-loop failure path, and DACL-only restore. QA's two iteration-2 flips were its own tests' staleness, not defects: the ipc denial is now proven locale-independently via the never-localized '(os error 5)' suffix (this host renders Win32 messages in Chinese) and the plan contract was strengthened to assert ZERO traversal grants plus exact grant-set == profile-root-set equality. Only remaining failure across 953 cumulative tests is the pre-declared plan_schema 18-vs-35 baseline; one cosmetic note for a future round: the build_appcontainer_launch_plan doc comment (services/sandbox/windows.rs:703-704) still mentions 'traversal-only grants' that the code below it deliberately no longer mints.
